sourceVersion: Fontana Unified 2027-2028 School Calendar, Board Approved 9/25/24
heroSummary: Fontana students return August 5, with Wednesday minimum days continuing across the school year. October conference days apply to elementary and middle schools, while the May 23–25 minimum-day window is reserved for high school final exams.
seoTitle: Fontana Unified Calendar 2027-2028 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Fontana Unified Calendar 2027-2028 with first day, last day, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, minimum days, Spanish PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: Fontana Unified starts the 2027-2028 school year on August 5, 2027 and ends on May 25, 2028. The board-approved calendar lists Fall Break from November 22-26, Winter Break from December 20-January 7, Spring Break from March 20-24, weekly Wednesday minimum days, elementary and middle school conference minimum days from October 18-22, high school final exam minimum days from December 14-17 and May 23-25, and a Spanish school year calendar PDF.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fontana Unified start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fontana Unified starts school on Thursday, August 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fontana Unified Fall Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, November 22 through Friday, November 26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fontana Unified Winter Break in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 20, 2027 through Friday, January 7, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fontana Unified Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 20 through Friday, March 24, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fontana Unified in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for all grades is Thursday, May 25, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Fontana Unified publish a Spanish 2027-2028 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Fontana Unified publishes a Spanish school year calendar PDF for 2027-2028.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Fontana Unified calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Fontana Unified ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: How We Verify Fontana Unified Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Fontana Unified school year calendars page and board-approved calendar PDFs, then compares key dates such as first day, last day, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, professional development days, member directed days, minimum days, conference windows, semester dates, finals windows, and translated calendar links before converting the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Fontana Unified calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
